blockers: The transaction could not be empirically tested because recon-only rules prohibited calling the generation POST endpoint or settling a payment.
A funded x402 Base-USDC or MPP Tempo-USDC wallet would be required for paid use.
trust_events: The domain was registered on 2026-07-16, but its terms claim an effective date of 2026-06-01; searches found no independent company footprint.

Named customers, testimonials, corporate identity, and compliance claims could not be independently verified. The legal pages provide email addresses but no physical address, incorporation jurisdiction, or company number; I would warn the user before payment.
notes: The primary service is API-based AI image generation. The concrete agent path is POST /v1/images/generate through agents.driftflight.com, receive HTTP 402, sign/pay using x402 or MPP, then retry programmatically. Pay-as-you-go prices are $0.01/sketch image, $0.06/studio image, and $0.14/gallery image, with no subscription; paid storefront renders receive a commercial license, failed renders are not billed, and hosted output URLs remain available for 90 days. The optional three-image free allowance requires a claimed agent identity and verified email, but the paid pay-as-you-go path documents no account, email confirmation, CAPTCHA, KYC, or sales call, so no_human_gate is true by inference from the published flow. Sources: [live catalog](https://agents.driftflight.com/manifest.json), [agent guide](https://agents.driftflight.com/llms-full.txt), [OpenAPI](https://api.driftflight.com/openapi.json), [pricing](https://driftflight.com/pricing), [terms](https://driftflight.com/terms), [x402 buyer documentation](https://docs.x402.org/getting-started/quickstart-for-buyers), [Verisign RDAP](https://rdap.verisign.com/com/v1/domain/driftflight.com).
